AlarmDescription: No EventBridge Scheduler invocation attempt in schedule group default for 7 consecutive days: the weekly grocery-ingest schedules (Fri 17:00 ET, Sat continue) stopped firing. Scheduler metrics have no per-schedule dimension (checked 2026-11-15), and a weekly schedule has zero attempts on 6 of 7 days, hence 7 daily periods. Snowflake sensors catch a missing run on Saturday; this is the independent AWS-side check.
